meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 当用户要求用大白话解释某个技术概念时，Claude 会从谁、什么、哪里、为什么、何时五个角度进行通俗易懂的说明。
howto.when: 当用户说“用大白话解释一下”或类似请求时触发。

say.text: 用大白话解释一下区块链
say.note: Claude 会从五个角度通俗解释区块链。

say.text: 给我讲讲什么是API，说人话
say.note: Claude 会以通俗方式解释API。

howto.what_en: When the user asks for a plain-English breakdown of something technical, Claude explains it from the who, what, where, why, and when perspectives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says something like 'explain in plain English' or similar requests.

say_en.note: Claude will break it down from five angles.

say_en.text: Tell me what an API is, in simple terms
say_en.note: Claude will explain API in plain language.
